release: People DEV — Editorial People Registry snapshot 2026-09-28
editorial_note: Generated only from owner-approved PEOPLE records in the INDEX:80 Editorial People Registry. Public identity follows the identity a person uses themselves in the relevant public Cardano context; INDEX:80 does not deanonymise people. Avatar URLs are populated only after image-use approval.

people.name: Adam Dean
people.bio: Adam Dean is a long-standing Cardano builder and a co-founder of several ecosystem projects, including Buffy Bot, NFTxLV and DripDropz, and is associated with early Cardano NFT infrastructure. Publishing on GitHub as Crypto2099, Adam Dean describes the work behind Buffy Bot Publishing and a background as a former Cardano stake pool operator. Adam Dean is also an active contributor to the Cardano Improvement Proposals repository, including editor work and recent proposals on on-chain stake pool registration and Cardano URIs.
current_roles: Contributor and editor, Cardano Improvement Proposals

people.name: Andrew Westberg
people.bio: Andrew Westberg is a long-standing Cardano developer and the CTO of W3i, the company behind the USDM stablecoin. Andrew Westberg created CNCLI, a command-line tool used by Cardano stake pool operators, and the earlier JorManager stake pool manager; Guild Operators documentation identifies CNCLI as created and maintained by Andrew Westberg. Andrew Westberg is also associated with NEWM, DripDropz and the BCSH stake pools. The CTO role at W3i is corroborated by current W3i and LinkedIn material.

people.name: Ant / Anthony_Bloom_
people.bio: Ant, publishing on X as @Anthony_Bloom_, is a Cardano community member whose public profile lists Bloom Pool, DripDropz and Se7en Labs and links the Bloom site. Bloom runs a family of Cardano stake pools. Ant's public activity also shows ongoing governance and ecosystem participation. INDEX:80 has not yet verified the exact role Ant holds at each of these organisations, or any DRep registration, so this record shows no stake pool or DRep badge until the pool operator and governance details are confirmed.

people.name: Anuj Chaudhary
people.bio: Anuj Chaudhary spent nearly three years at EMURGO, working across Cardano Spot, the Yoroi and DeFi wallet, stablecoin and governance work, and wrote EMURGO's Cardano blockchain India market deep-dive. Anuj Chaudhary is now Head of Strategy at Paraa Crypto, an Indian crypto exchange, and the founder of the INRC stablecoin project (INR Grid), which describes itself as building on Cardano and Polygon, as well as the PerpX perpetuals exchange. Earlier experience includes Bloomberg and CoinW.
historic_roles: EMURGO — Cardano Spot, Yoroi/DeFi wallet, stablecoin and governance work

people.name: Apex
people.bio: Apex is the founder and CEO of ATLAS and Titans, and has been building blockchain infrastructure on Cardano since 2021. ATLAS is a stablecoin-first perpetual futures exchange on Cardano built around unified liquidity vaults. Titans builds and operates blockchain infrastructure, with a track record spanning DePIN and Bitcoin mining infrastructure. INDEX:80 records Apex under the public identity used on X as @Apex_333, and both Titans and Atlas are listed as INDEX:80 projects.
